integrity: Exact group-theoretic and cyclotomic proof; independent finite integer checker is corroborative and not a substitute for the all-prime argument.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the digit-lift diagonal family in the prime-square group only; counts labeled spectra. No claim on arbitrary polynomial graphs, higher powers, phase retrieval, or quantitative stability. Bibliographic equivalence remains a residual risk.
title: All exponential spectra of prime-square digit-lift graphs
